response: Mechanical Engineering applies physics and materials science to design, manufacturing, and maintenance of mechanical systems. Labs include CAED, CAMD, and more. Graduates work in manufacturing, robotics, automotive, and other industries. Want details on the curriculum?

response: Civil Engineering at SDIT emphasises quality education in scientific principles, materials, analysis, and design. Labs include material testing, surveying, hydraulic, CAD, environmental, and geotech labs. Interested in the career opportunities?

response: Electronics & Communication Engineering prepares students for careers in telecommunications and computing. The B.E program is VTU-affiliated. Labs include analog electronics, logic design, microcontrollers, DSP, VLSI, and power electronics. Want to know about placements in this field?

response: Aeronautical Engineering covers aircraft design, stability, propulsion, aerodynamics, and space technology. The department uses project-based learning so students solve real-world problems. Graduates work in defence, aerospace, and aviation industries. Curious about the labs?
